{"task": {"id": "I_kwDONElfw88AAAABUjzJcw", "item_id": "PVTI_lAHOAHSLSM4BlV6Pzg-FTeA", "project_id": "PVT_kwHOAHSLSM4BlV6P", "number": 4, "title": "Restore Three.js MMD modules as a standalone addon", "body": "## Problem

Three.js removed its MMD-related addon modules in r172. As a result, applications using current Three.js releases can no longer import MMDLoader and its related modules from the official Three.js addons.

## Expected outcome

Provide the MMD functionality removed from Three.js as a standalone third-party addon in this repository.

Completion criteria:

- Bring the MMD-related runtime modules removed from Three.js into this repository, using the r171 versions as the starting point.
- Include the modules required to use MMDLoader, including the relevant loader, animation, physics, parser, and shader dependencies that were removed together with the MMD modules.
- Use `three` as an external dependency rather than vendoring Three.js itself.
- Expose the public MMD modules so consumers can import them from this package in a straightforward way comparable to Three.js addons.
- Ensure the imported modules work with the Three.js version targeted by this repository.
- Add automated validation sufficient to verify that the package can be installed/built and that its public modules can be imported.

Do not include the browser examples or deployment pipeline in this Issue; those are tracked separately.

## Context

Three.js PR mrdoob/three.js#30003, “Addons: Remove MMD modules,” removed the deprecated MMD modules for the r172 milestone.

MMDLoader still exists in Three.js r171 at:

`examples/jsm/loaders/MMDLoader.js`

The removal PR also removed related modules such as:

- `examples/jsm/animation/CCDIKSolver.js`
- `examples/jsm/animation/MMDAnimationHelper.js`
- `examples/jsm/animation/MMDPhysics.js`
- `examples/jsm/exporters/MMDExporter.js`
- `examples/jsm/libs/mmdparser.module.js`
- `examples/jsm/loaders/MMDLoader.js`
- `examples/jsm/shaders/MMDToonShader.js`

This repository is intended to continue providing the MMD functionality outside the Three.js repository.", "url": "https://github.com/takahirox/three-mmd-loader/issues/4", "created_at": "2026-10-02T08:07:30Z", "state": "OPEN", "repository": "takahirox/three-mmd-loader", "labels": ["task"], "priority": null, "status": "In Progress", "is_archived": false}, "context": {}, "resources": {}, "allocation": {}, "instruction": null, "run_id": "9d3d0b6422ad4ca5b3dad2e4784f7264"}
